items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: And then, that bass player, I call his name another night, Willie Predonce. Johnny Predonce. Johnny Predonce. Johnny Predonce. Yeah, Johnny Predonce. And we get in there and we start to play.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about that bass player? Because once when I asked Albert Blinney who was the first one that he ever heard pick on the bass, and slap it and all that, he thought that this, I can't pronounce the name Predonce. Predonce?
Predonce, yeah. Johnny Predonce. I think that's it.
Do you remember anything about him when you were, he must have been pretty young when you first heard him, I guess?
